subject: Re: Marketplace listing variants and regional prioritization for co-sell
messages:
From: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@marketplace-partner.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace packaging / co-sell — initial asks

Neha — thanks again for the intro. We’re mapping out listing variants for the three clouds and want to align on three things before we draft the final listing assets:

1) Which SKU variants should we publish per cloud (entry/standard/enterprise vs usage tiers)?
2) Region rollout order (US first, or split US + EU initially?)
3) Co-sell eligibility & pricing parity expectations (do we need identical SKUs/prices across AWS/Azure/GCP to qualify for co-sell?)

Quick context: Priya (cc’d) is evaluating the Azure/AWS co-sell routing for our joint pilot; AWS wants a clear enterprise SKU with a committed capacity option.

Can you share Redwood’s recommendation and any constraints from Dedicated/Private offerings? If helpful, I can share our internal marketplace checklist.

Attachments: none in this note (will attach the partner checklist in follow-ups).

—Carlos
Head of Partnerships, CloudMarket Co.

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@marketplace-partner.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@datacloud.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace packaging / co-sell — initial asks

Carlos — thanks for the clear summary. High level recommendations from Redwood’s GTM + partnerships POV (see short matrix below). I’m attaching a first-pass listing_variant_matrix_v1.xlsx with concrete SKU names and required metadata per cloud.

Summary recommendations (short):
- SKU strategy: publish three canonical SKUs across clouds — Starter (metered, low-commit), Business (monthly seat/commit + measured tokens), Enterprise (annual commit + dedicated SLA).
- Variantization: publish lightweight "Add-on" SKUs for Dedicated capacity and Private deployments (visible on listings but flagged as "contact sales / private offer").
- Region rollout: US + EU simultaneously for Business/Enterprise SKUs to support co-sell; Starter can be US-first to accelerate listing. GCP prioritize US/EU then APAC for later tranche.
- Pricing parity & co-sell: AWS/Azure require reasonably aligned commercial terms for co-sell routing; we should present identical SKU names and matching MMR ranges per SKU family, but allow cloud-specific marketplace fees to be surfaced separately. Committed capacity options should be present for all three clouds to be co-sell eligible.

Operational constraints:
- Dedicated (Reserved) SKUs require lead time for capacity mapping — recommend gating Dedicated listing with a note: "Provisioning subject to capacity confirmation."
- Private/VPC offerings must use "contact sales" flow; do not expose usage-based metering there.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment call (30m) to agree matrix (option: Friday 10/22 10:00 PT).
2) Share a single-sheet listing matrix with the partner and AWS (attached).
3) Follow-up on co-sell doc requirements (AWS asks: proof of SLA, support SLA, and pricing buckets).

I’ll defer to Karthik and Marissa for legal/ops and marketplace publication questions — tagging them below.

—Neha
Director, Partnerships & GTM, Redwood Inference

Attachment: listing_variant_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@marketplace-partner.com>, AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@datacloud.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace packaging / co-sell — initial asks

Couple of operational/legal notes from my side (I reviewed Neha’s matrix):

1) Pricing parity: we can maintain identical SKU nomenclature across clouds, but contract terms (billing cadence, marketplace fees) will differ — we should include a short footnote per SKU indicating "list price vs effective customer price" and how marketplace fees are applied.
2) Listing artifacts: need approved logos, a short 60-75 word product summary per SKU, and the security claims page. For Enterprise SKU we must attach the SOC2 letter + data flows doc.
3) Private/Dedicated: Contracts team requests a minimum commitment template for Dedicated SKU (90-day provisioning SLA + on-boarding fee). That can live behind Private/Reserved offers.

Operational ask to Marissa: can you validate the publication lead times per cloud and add "time to GA" field in the matrix?

I’m fine with the US+EU simultaneous launch for Business/Enterprise; APAC to follow once Marketplace regional controls are tested.

-Karthik
Head of Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-22T15:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace packaging / co-sell — initial asks

Looping back after ops sync. I’ve populated the time-to-GA and checked off the minimum artifacts in the attached PDF (co-sell_playback_notes_20261022.pdf). Key operational decisions:

- Time to list (optimistic): AWS 4 weeks, Azure 5 weeks, GCP 6 weeks (due to additional VAT/tax onboarding in some regions).
- Required artifacts for first publish: 3 screenshots, 60-word summary, 1-minute video (optional), SOC2 in listing (Enterprise), link to support SLA page.
- Marketplace billing nuance: for Starter we recommend metered billing only on AWS and GCP for speed; Azure prefers offer-based SKUs — we’ll model a mapped "Starter (Offer)" to preserve parity.

Operational asks for partner: please send final marketing assets and the preferred enterprise commitment tiers by EOD Monday 10/26 so we can lock publish dates.

Carlos — if AWS team can confirm co-sell routing criteria by next Tue that helps.

Thanks — attaching the playback notes and updated matrix.

—Marissa
Sr. Product Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: co-sell_playback_notes_20261022.pdf

Date: 2026-10-23T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace packaging / co-sell — initial asks

Hi all,

AWS side — thanks for the matrix. Quick confirmation: AWS co-sell routing requires an Enterprise offer with a published Private Offer option (for committed capacity) or a Marketplace Seller Private Offer (SPO) flow with matching SKUs. Pricing parity at the SKU family level is sufficient (names + ranges); minor list price differences allowed to account for marketplace fees.

Action items we’ll take on:
- Confirm co-sell routing checklist by 10/27.
- Confirm whether the Private Offer requires DocuSign of a bespoke MSA before listing (we will follow up).

We’ll plan to route any eligible leads once Enterprise SKU is live in US + EU. Good to go on the proposed sequencing.

—AWS Marketplace Partner Team
